name: zclass_world_remove_sound
description: zClass_World::RemoveSound detaches a sound from world sound arrays and the sound's attached-world list.

functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x451640 searches the world sound node list, shifts sound node/data arrays down, decrements world soundCount, searches the sound's attachedWorlds list, shifts it down, decrements attachedWorldCount, and emits the debug buffer with return 5 when either side is missing.
